messages.text:
Happy to. Which state or country will it run in? I'll price it there, and if you know your per-kWh rate, give me that too and I'll use your real number.

The Magic Miner 40T is $799, 40 TH/s at about 650W, tunable 30 to 50 TH/s, quiet enough for a desk at ~50 dB in Eco. Batch 5, ships November 14, 2026.

Ran these for DFW at the Texas average of 15.5 cents a kWh. Tell me your real rate and I'll redo it.

Magic Miner 40T, $799: stacks about 57,350 sats a month, worth roughly $47.75 today. Power at 650W runs about $73.50 a month, so you're about $26 under water at today's BTC price. Break-even is BTC at $128,167. Solo block hit pays around $261,800, odds about 0.22% over a year.

Harlo B30, $899: 43,000 sats a month, $45.80 power, break-even $106,477.

At Texas retail rates this is sat-stacking and a lottery ticket, not profit. The 40T gives you more hashrate per dollar; the B30 costs less to run. Which matters more to you?
I would say the hashrate would be more important.

Then the Magic Miner 40T is your unit. 40 TH/s stock, $19.98 per TH, and you can push it to 50 TH/s in Turbo at 850W if you want more shots at a block. Ships November 14, 2026, $799.

One honest caveat: at 650W it puts real heat and about 50 dB into the room, so a garage or utility space suits it better than a bedroom.

Want me to build the checkout?

Thank you for the info and the honesty!!  Do you think 0.22% is padded some, or do you think that's a fairly accurate percentage?  I'm just kicking around the idea of doing this.  I was looking at Bitcoin merch's version of this model, but I'm leaning towards yours.  They both seem to perform pretty much the same.

It's straight math, not marketing. 40 TH/s against a 132.8T network, over a year of blocks, works out to about 0.22%. The one place it's optimistic: difficulty keeps climbing, so in practice call it a bit under that. Roughly one chance in 450 years of running it.

So buy it for the sats and the lottery ticket, not the odds. On the competitor, I won't run down a unit I can't see specs on. Anything else before you decide?
Nope, that just about covers everything.  Thank your help!!

Glad it helped, and good luck whichever way you go.

Before you go, one thing: what's making you lean our 40T over the Bitcoin Merch unit if they perform about the same?
